name: Tolerance
text: An invoice whose total discrepancy is at most INR 500 AND at most 2 percent of the invoice subtotal is auto-closed with a one-line note. No room opens.

name: Citations
text: Every factual claim cites file name and row, e.g. goods_receipts.csv GRN-4412. A claim without a citation is not allowed; say unknown instead.

name: Received quantity
text: Only the warehouse_lead can confirm received quantity. If a human statement conflicts with goods_receipts.csv or delivery_challans.csv, classify as conflict and ask the warehouse_lead to recount.

name: Price variance
text: Only the buyer on the PO can accept a price variance. A price counts as justified only if a price_list.csv row was effective on or before the PO date.

name: Approval threshold
text: If the disputed amount (before GST) exceeds INR 50,000, the ap_manager must approve the decision.

name: Questions
text: Evidence agent asks at most 2 questions per room, each yes/no, each addressed to one role.

name: External messages
text: Agents draft only. Nothing goes to a vendor until the ap_clerk types SEND.

name: Closing
text: Each room ends with a decision record: cause, evidence cited, who decided, action, amount.
